description: A free look label for client sessions. Burns a label and notes into the frame for up to eight looks, and when you change Active Look it flips your look nodes for you, clip or timeline, split looks included. Label a node to match the look (or just Look 1, Look 2) and it turns on while the others turn off. Bottom, Top and Center positions, plus a PowerGrade Mode that fills the frame with the label so Gallery stills show which look they hold. Garamond, Pixel or your own fonts.
releaseHighlights:
- Free. No licence key, no watermark, no sign up.
- Eight looks, each with its own label and notes, burned right into the image so the client always knows which look they are seeing.
- Change Active Look and Look Notes flips your look nodes for you: label a node to match the look (or just "Look 1", "Look 2") and it turns on while the others turn off.
- Works on clip nodes and at the timeline level, and a repeated label across a split look flips every matching node together.
- Position: Bottom, Top or Center, plus PowerGrade Mode that fills the frame with just the label so Gallery stills show which look they hold.
- Garamond, Pixel or your own fonts, with colour, size, opacity and alignment controls.
- How To Set Up button opens a step by step guide.
- Runs on the GPU. macOS universal Metal build, Windows and Linux CUDA builds.
